jamie (oncall): incidentbot just opened PagerDuty incident PD-20260315-01 for monitor `synthetic-canary-latency` — 4 triggers within 3m, paging primary oncall
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert created (PD-20260315-01) — monitor: synthetic-canary-latency — threshold 300ms — status: triggered
jamie (oncall): ack'ing, grabbing canary dashboard and logs
olivia (sre): seeing a short, sharp p95 blip in us-east only. prod user traffic looks flat. likely synthetic-only
jamie (oncall): p95 jumped ~110ms -> ~460ms for ~25s then recovered. traces show rotor proxy queueing spike
nick (eng-runtime): can you post the query you used? want to correlate with kv-cache miss rate
jamie (oncall): query pasted:
```
S: percentile(latency_ms,95) from metrics.requests where env='prod' and route=~'/canary/.*' since -10m by 1m
```
jamie (oncall): `kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep rotor` — rotor-7 shows restart correlating with spike
deploy-bot: pod/rotor-7 restarted (OOMKilled) at ~2026-03-15T11:12:10Z
olivia (sre): kernel OOM log present. looks like memory pressure triggered eviction then oom_kill
jamie (oncall): PD auto-resolved after no further triggers for 6m :white_check_mark: — leaving notes here
jamie (oncall): proposing immediate mitigation: apply soft silence to the canary monitor for 15m while we adjust sizing
olivia (sre): silenced via pd-cli: `pd silence --service synthetic-canary-latency --duration 15m` — done :thumbsup:
nick (eng-runtime): I'll open PR to increase rotor pod requests from 1.4Gi -> 2Gi in canary pool and tweak autoscaler buffer. Will add a Prometheus alert for rotor memory pressure > 85%
jamie (oncall): also add a runbook step to temporarily silence synthetic-only alerts during maintenance windows; ticket INFRA-7890 created
olivia (sre): customer impact: none detected. marking as no-customer-impact and adding to incident meta
nick (eng-runtime): quick log snippet:
```
[11:11:52] rotor-7 WARN mem=1398Mi threshold=1300Mi
[11:12:00] rotor-7 ERROR gc triggered evict
[11:12:10] kernel oom_kill invoked, process rotor-worker pid=2345
```
jamie (oncall): handing follow-up to runtime -> nick to own PR + validate canary autoscaler hysteresis. ETA 3h
nick (eng-runtime): got it. will link PR and add notes to incidents repo
jamie (oncall): keeping the thread until PR lands. if PD refires we'll escalate to infra and consider rolling change rollback
